name: Small Ample Classes Have Corners
statement: Every nonempty ample class on at most seven coordinates has a corner and therefore has a complete corner peeling. Every maximum class on at most eight coordinates has a corner. Consequently, a cornerless ample class on eight active coordinates has no peripheral coordinate and no nontrivial Cartesian product decomposition.
proof: The exact formulas $F_{n,d}$ with lex leaders are certified unsatisfiable for all 15 cases $3\le d\le n\le7$; the structural dimension bound handles smaller VC dimensions. Repeated corner deletion preserves ampleness, giving a complete peeling. For maximum classes on eight coordinates, the four possible cornerless dimensions $3\le d\le6$ are excluded by checked $M_{8,d}$ certificates. Peripheral or product descent from a cornerless eight-coordinate class would produce a cornerless ample class on at most seven coordinates, contradicting the first result.
comments: This is computer-assisted. The mathematical reductions use the exact encodings and the local structural lemmas. The explicit CNF digests, DRAT proofs or proof digests, and checker logs remain in the cited evidence directories.
